text:
Laura (Partnerships): Hey team — quick sync on the 'Battlestation' co-hosted session with EdgeWorks next month. Need run-of-show, speaker bios, and a plan for swag handoff. Can we lock timelines by EOD?
Anil (FieldEng): I can own demo infra and fallbacks. question: will we run site-local GPUs or cloud instances for the hands-on?
Laura (Partnerships): EdgeWorks prefers hybrid — they want a local node for the hardware demo + a cloud fallback. Dan, can logistics support a local kit and a same-day courier fallback?
Dan (Logistics): short answer: yes for local kit. courier same-day depends on airport cutoffs. i'll map two drop points and a backup courier.
Maria (Marketing): I'll draft the joint event blurb and speaker blurbs. Also want to confirm sticker/tee count. What's the attendee cap?
Laura (Partnerships): Expect ~120 seats. Recommend 150 stickers, 60 tees, 20 demo loaners. Jess, can we include a quick onboarding notebook for attendees?
Jess (DevEx): Yep — I have a 10-min lab notebook that provisions a sandbox on Redwood Dedicated. Will add cloud fallback steps. Putting a snippet here for ops to review:
```
# quickstart snippet
rdw create-sandbox --model edgetiny-quant --max-seq 512 --region us-west-2
rdw deploy-demo --name battlestation-lab --cache-prefix attendee-{id}
```
Laura (Partnerships): Nice. Anil, any kernel/quantization caveats for the hardware demo we should call out?
Anil (FieldEng): EdgeWorks kit is A100-ish with custom nv driver; recommend we run quantized 4-bit variant locally. Also suggest lowering batch to 1 for latency-sensitive parts. Will prepare a compatibility checklist.
Dan (Logistics): Question on swag handoff: do we want pre-bagged attendee packs or booth pickup? Pre-bagged increases courier weight and customs.
Maria (Marketing): Let's do pre-bagged for VIPs + booth pickup for general attendees. We'll announce VIP pickup in the registration flow.
Laura (Partnerships): Good. Ops-bot, can you create a calendar invite for the run-through with EdgeWorks leads and set a CI build to exercise the demo?
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Created event "Battlestation run-through" 2025-10-14 10:00 PDT. CI job created: battlestation/demo-smoke (logs archived).
Jess (DevEx): CI smoke log snippet attached in our repo. I can point the guest speaker guide to the exact run deck.
Anil (FieldEng): For the demo fallback, propose this order: local hardware -> dedicated cloud (pinned model) -> hosted lightweight model. If capacity issues, auto-fail to hosted.
Laura (Partnerships): That routing policy sounds right. Maria — I'll need the final co-brand assets by next Wednesday. Also confirm if EdgeWorks will ship their own partner swag or we handle consolidated packs.
Maria (Marketing): EdgeWorks will send 30 co-branded notebooks; we'll consolidate everything into packs. Dan, can you include a customs sheet for the partner ship?
Dan (Logistics): Will do. Also creating a label template. ETA for packing list? two days.
Laura (Partnerships): Awesome. Action items: Anil -> compatibility checklist + fallback policy (due in 48h). Jess -> lab notebook + CI link (24h). Maria -> co-brand assets + swag counts (48h). Dan -> courier plan + customs sheet (48h). EdgeWorks rep (cc'd in event) will confirm speaker names and hardware serials.
Anil (FieldEng): I'll flag any perf caveats in a short doc.
Maria (Marketing): Will coordinate registration email language and VIP flow.
Jess (DevEx): I'll draft a 3-slide speaker guide with what to demo and timing.
Laura (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers post-run-through we escalate to the release-war-room channel.
EdgeWorks Bot: Speaker list received. Please upload A/V requirements here: https://files.redwood.ai/edgeworks/battlestation/av
Dan (Logistics): FYI i'll drop shipping label drafts in #partnerships later today.
Maria (Marketing): :sparkles: Love the plan. ping me if we need more promo budget.
Laura (Partnerships): End-of-thread check: next sync after the run-through is locked — ops-bot added reminder 48h before event. Thanks team!"
